premise: Aryavarta mein Senapati Rudra ne coup kar diya hai. Aakhri wafadar royal guard Agni Mani leke bhaaga aur tumhare gaon mein gir pada — marne se pehle Mani tumhe de gaya. Ab Rudra ke sipahi tumhare peeche hain. Mani ko 3 din mein Surya Mandir ke kund mein rakhna hai, warna uski shakti bikhar jayegi. Saath hain: 'naukarani' Devika (jo Rajkumari hai) aur Kalu kauwa.

locations.name: Pipalkheda gaon
locations.description: Aam ka bagh, purana peepal, aur ab Rudra ke sipahiyon ki aahat.

locations.name: Kaal Jungle
locations.description: Ghana jungle; andar short-cut bhi hai aur khatra bhi.

locations.name: Chambal kinaare
locations.description: Ufanti nadi — paar karne ke liye purani naav ya tairna.

locations.name: Surya Mandir
locations.description: Sunehri gumbad wala prachin mandir; kund ke beech Mani-sthal.

factions.name: Wafadar
factions.description: Chhupe hue royal supporters — Devika aur Guru Vishnu ke saath.

factions.name: Rudra ki sena
factions.description: 20 sipahi; Rudra ke dar se wafadar, dil se nahi.

lore: Agni Mani 500 saal pehle Surya dev ke vardaan se bani thi.
Mani sirf shuddh mann wale ke haath mein chamakti hai; lalchi ke haath mein pathhar.
Surya Mandir ka kund Mani ki asli jagah hai.
Coup ke baad Raja nazarband hai, par zinda hai.
rules: The Mani NEVER works for Rudra — it turns to stone in greedy hands.
Devika's identity stays secret until the temple confrontation.
No character dies. Battles end in capture, escape, or surrender.
Kalu can scout but cannot carry the Mani (too heavy, he claims; actually he's lazy).
The user is the Mani-bearer — the Mani glows for them.

importantObjects.name: Agni Mani
importantObjects.description: Aag jaisi chamakti ratna; lalchi haathon mein pathhar.

importantObjects.name: Jungle ka naksha
importantObjects.description: Kalu ka banaya hua tedha-medha naksha. Kaam karta hai. Mostly.

timeline: Din 1 subah — guard gaon mein girta hai, Mani milti hai
Din 1 shaam — Rudra ke sipahi gaon pahunchte hain
Din 2 — jungle aur nadi ka safar
Din 3 suryast — Surya Mandir mein aakhri muqabla
